Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (as amended) - Audio 
recording of Conference Call for the Audited Financial Results for the quarter and year 
ended March 31, 2026. 
 
This is in furtherance to our letter dated May 05, 2026, intimating about the Conference call 
for the Analysts and Investors to discuss the Audited Financial Results for the quarter and 
year ended March 31, 2026. 
 
Pursuant to the Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (as amended), the audio 
recording of the Conference call held today i.e. on Tuesday, May 12, 2026 on the Audited 
Financial Results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, is available on the website 
of the Company at www.advancedenzymes.com/investors/analyst-corner. 
 
Further, the transcript of the aforesaid Conference call will be intimated to the Stock 
Exchanges in due course and uploaded on the website of the Company at the aforesaid link. 
 
The aforesaid information is also being uploaded on the website of the Company.  
Thanking you, 
Yours Faithfully, 
For Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited 
 
 
Sanjay Basantani 
Company Secretary and Head – Legal 
SANJAY 
PRAKASH 
BASANTANI
Digitally signed by
